M8/#624, JUDGE W DOUGLASS, CSR R BARULICH, CLK H HAMILTON 1400: CASE CALLED FOR SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE, ALL PARTIES PRESENT IN PROPRIA PERSONA. SETTLED, AS FOLLOWS: STIPULATED JUDGMENT FOR PLAINTIFF AND AGAINST DEFENDANTS FOR POSSESSION OF THE PROPERTY AT 438 CAMPBELL AVE, SF. RENTAL AGREEMENT FORFEITED, NO EXECUTION IF DEFENDANTS VACATE BY MIDNIGHT 3-31-98. IF DEFENDANTS FAIL TO COMPLY, A WRIT MAY IMMEDIATELY ISSUE WITH NO STAY. POSSESSIONS LEFT AFTER DEFENDANTS VACATE WILL BE DEEMED ABANDONED. PLAINTIFF WAIVES ALL UNPAID RENT, WILL RETURN SECURITY DEPOSIT WHEN DEFENDANTS VACATE, AND WILL PROVIDE A NEUTRAL REFERENCE. DEFENDANTS TO ALLOW PLAINTIFF ACCESS TO MAKE REPAIRS REQUIRED BY BUILDING INSPECTORS. PLAINTIFF WILL SEE IF REPAIRS CAN BE POSTPONED UNTIL AFTER DEFENDANTS MOVE OUT, IF NOT DEFENDANTS WILL ALLOW ACCESS. EACH SIDE TO BEAR OWN COSTS. PLAINTIFF TO PREPARE JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF TO FILE A SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT AFTER DEFENDANTS VACATE.
TRIAL OFF CALENDAR

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BOUCHET, GLENDA SUED AS BOUCHET, GLENDA BONDS BOUCHET, PASCAL THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 438 CAMPBELL AVE, S.F., STAYED UNTIL MAR-31-1998, LEASE FORFEITED, WRIT OF POSSESSION MAY ISSUE IF DEFS HAVE NOT VACATED BY 3-31-98 MIDNIGHT. NO MONEY JDGMT, SEC DEP RET IF VAC BY 3-31-98. EACH BEAR OWN COSTS, PLTF TO GIVE NEUTRAL REF. PLTF TO FILE SATISFACTION IF DEFTS VAC BY 3-31-98 MIDNIGHT SEE JUDGMENT FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS
